title: The Time in Your Hand
lyrics:
(Verse 1: Harry Chapin)
The calendar flips and the years start to run
I used to chase shadows while ignoring the sun
But the clock on the wall doesn't wait for a man
And I missed all the magic, the best that I can
Now I see you standing, with the time in your hand
With Ruby and Wesley, building castles in sand
Don't trade the present for a promise of gold
Or a "someday" that leaves you out in the cold.

(Verse 2: Stevie Nicks)
It’s a landslide of moments, a shift in the light
Watching them grow up, from the day to the night
You’re looking for answers in the words that you say
But they’re watching your actions, they’re carving their way
The mountains are changing, the seasons are bold
And your children are stories that wait to be told
Keep the love steady, let the walls tumble down
The greatest of treasures is right here in town.

(Verse 3: Rodney Atkins)
It ain’t just the talking, it’s the life that you live
It’s the grace that you show, and the love that you give
When they’re watching you work, when they’re watching you pray
They’re learning the map for their own coming day
You’re the hero, the compass, the rock in the sea
So be present and patient, just let yourself be
In the mess and the laughter, the noise and the fray
That’s where the life happens, day after day.

(Verse 4: Kenny Chesney)
You worry the years are just slipping away
But look at the beauty, look where you stay
It’s the coastal horizon, the wind in the trees
It’s the quiet communion when you’re down on your knees
That life that you’re building? It’s not in the grind
It’s the love for your family you’re leaving behind
You’re doing just fine, yeah, you’re hitting your stride
With Ruby and Wesley right there by your side.

(Chorus: All Together)
So slow down the spin, let the world fade to gray
It’s the love in the home that will light up the way
Don’t wait for "someday," be who you are
You’ve got the universe right in your car
The cradle is rocking, the time is a ghost
Love who you have, the ones you love most.

(Outro)
(Harry) Keep them close...
(Stevie) Let them fly...
(Rodney) Watch them grow...
(Kenny) And never say goodbye to the time you have now.

(Verse 1: Harry Chapin)
I’ve walked the road where the clocks run fast,
Trading the present for the shadow of the past.
I’m telling you, friend, before the day is done,
Don’t let the calendar outrun your son.
The silver spoon is polished, but the cradle is cold,
If you wait for the future, you’ll just grow old.
And look at the faces, the joy in the air,
Ruby and Wesley, they're waiting right there.
